column3: The phone screen shows the Due Meld SCAN A LETTER screen in light theme recreated from the attached screenshot: top “×” and title “Scan a letter”; a small illustration of a paper letter and a phone with marigold scan corners; huge bold plum “Snap the page with the date”; grey “A renewal notice, bill, form or screenshot. We’ll find the deadline and show you where we found it.”; three white rounded option tiles with icons: “Camera · Choose photos”, “Photos · Pick up to 5”, “PDF · Up to 15 MB”; tips with green ticks “Lay the page flat in good light”, “Keep all four corners in the photo”, “Screenshots of emails work too”; a wide marigold button “Add a page to continue” and text link “Type it in instead”. Floating OUTSIDE the phone around it: on the left a real paper bill and a folded insurance letter, on the right a small glossy PDF document icon and a screenshot of an email card “Your free trial ends Oct 29”, each with a thin glowing marigold line flowing into the phone.

The phone screen shows the Due Meld REMINDER TIME screen in light theme recreated from the attached screenshot: back arrow and title “Reminder time”; huge bold plum “When should we remind you?”; grey “On reminder days, one notification at this time.”; a grid of rounded white time buttons “7:00 AM”, “8:00 AM”, “9:00 AM” (selected, filled plum with white text), “10:00 AM”, “12:00 PM”, “2:00 PM”, “5:00 PM”, “6:00 PM”, “7:00 PM”, “8:00 PM”; a wide marigold button “Save time”. Floating OUTSIDE the phone: a big glossy marigold-and-cream alarm clock on the upper left and a glossy iOS notification card on the upper right “DUE MELD · 9:00 AM”, bold “Passport renewal in 30 days”, “Book your appointment”, with a soft morning-coffee mood.

The phone screen shows the Due Meld EXPORT MY DATA screen in light theme recreated from the attached screenshot: back arrow; a plum hero card with marigold label “Your data, anytime”, bold white “Export my data”, “Everything in your household, as a file you keep, whether or not you subscribe.”, chips “CSV for spreadsheets”, “JSON, everything”, “Always free”, and a small illustration of a box of papers and a clock; a list with icons: “Every deadline, open and done, with dates, amounts and notes”, “Each item’s reminder settings”, “Your household and who handles what”; a wide marigold button “Export as CSV (spreadsheet)” and a grey button “Export as JSON (everything)”. Floating OUTSIDE the phone: a glossy plum shield with a marigold lock on the left, and on the right two small glossy cards “Private to your household” (with a lock icon) and “Delete your account anytime” (with a trash icon).
